page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7i.32xlarge is an x86_64 bare-metal instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores and 128 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. This architecture ensures dedicated CPU allocation without resource sharing, providing predictable compute performance for demanding workloads.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 6.0 GB per core. For acceleration, it integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. This hardware configuration does not include local NVMe storage, requiring external block storage solutions for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

Given its bare-metal architecture, high core count, and quad-GPU configuration, this instance represents a dense resource profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require direct hardware access and parallel processing capabilities without hyperthreading overhead. Recommended workloads include deep learning inference, graphics rendering, parallel simulations, and compute-intensive scientific modeling.
